description:
AptiStockX is a cross-platform desktop stock charting and portfolio research app.

AptiStockX is a cross-platform desktop stock charting and portfolio research app with local watchlists, chart workspaces, technical indicators, drawing studies, portfolio tracking, and downloadable market data.
AptiStockX 3.0 is the public cross-platform release for Windows, macOS, and Linux. This version includes local watchlists, chart workspaces, technical indicators, drawing studies, portfolio tracking, downloadable market data workflows, and Basic/Pro licensing.
